content.text:
Use `toMatchTextContent`: `await expect.element(page.getByTestId('msg')).toMatchTextContent('phrase')`. It does a partial match and also accepts a RegExp, for example `/phrase/i` to ignore case.

Don't use `toHaveTextContent` for this. In Vitest 5 (you have 5.0.3) it requires the text to match exactly. So `toHaveTextContent('Content')` fails on an element whose text is "Text Content". I confirmed this in the installed type definitions (`node_modules/@vitest/browser/jest-dom.d.ts:408-440`).
